# Backdrop

```tsx
import { Backdrop } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para atenuar visualmente o conteúdo ao fundo, direcionando o foco para um elemento sobreposto.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<>
  <PageContent />
  <Backdrop {...args} />
</>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Backdrop: Background/Overlay over the whole screen, no blur. Modal, Drawer and Bottom Sheet render it through their Base UI Backdrop part, which adds the data-starting-style / data-ending-style used to fade it.

## Rules

- Import `Backdrop` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
